Any future misreporting could lead to misinformed financial decisions and impact stakeholder confidence.

### Conclusion

Amcor's restructuring liability of $45 million for Q2 FY2023 demonstrates stability year-over-year and a modest decrease quarter-over-quarter. Continued vigilance in data accuracy and reporting will be essential for maintaining stakeholder confidence and ensuring transparent financial communication.
